# Demo Company fixture

> **DEMO COMPANY — synthetic, clearly-marked sample Company** (GLOSSARY "Demo Company";
> rule B18-3). Used to learn the app and to QA the onboarding path
> (QA-CHECKLIST F-004 item 6: "Demo Company opens marked clearly"; RELEASE-CHECKLIST
> "Demo Company + 12 packs + sample GL dump QA'd"). **Never reachable from production
> data paths** — production imports always go through Manual Import / connectors.

## Contents

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `company.json` | Company metadata: **Acme Manufacturing** (synthetic name, TESTING-STRATEGY §6), Manufacturing Industry Pack, 12-month calendar (April start), USD, `en-US`, single Business Unit `bu-manu`, 1-year horizon, Actuals enabled |
| `gl_dump.csv` | Actuals GL dump — **byte-identical** to `docs/examples/sample_gl_dump.csv` (Canonical GL Template, GL-TEMPLATE-SPEC §2) |
| `gl_dump.expected.json` | Exact expected values (oracle sidecar, TEST-FIXTURES-SPEC §1): 480 rows, single period `2026-08` (P08), tie-out 937,976.64 balanced to the cent, per-account nets (storage sign, debit-positive), P&L rollup (presentation sign): Revenue 438,000.00 · COGS 153,300.00 · Gross Profit 284,700.00 · OpEx 127,676.64 · EBITDA 157,023.36 · Depreciation 14,599.92 · EBIT 142,423.44 · SHA256 of the CSV |

## Guarantees

- **Synthetic & deterministic** (B5): generated by `npm run fixtures:gen`
  (`scripts/gen-fixtures.py`, dependency-free Python 3); byte-identical across runs and
  machines; SHA256 recorded in `gl_dump.expected.json` so any drift fails QA.
- **Tie-out exact**: sum(debit) = sum(credit) = 937,976.64 (verified in the generator).
- **No real client data** (B18-3); no file > 50 MB (TEST-FIXTURES-SPEC §5).

## Ownership & renewal

Owner: Onboarding/Ingestion (per TEST-FIXTURES-SPEC §5). Renew when the Canonical GL
Template (GL-TEMPLATE-SPEC) or the Manufacturing Pack COA changes — regenerate with
`npm run fixtures:gen` and review the diff of `gl_dump.expected.json`.

*Referenced by: TEST-FIXTURES-SPEC.md, TESTING-STRATEGY.md, QA-CHECKLIST.md, RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md.*
